attendance-percentage-calculator.formula:
Percentage = (attended / held) x 100
Classes needed to reach 75% = ceil((0.75 x held - attended) / 0.25)
Classes you can miss (staying >= 75%) = floor(attended / 0.75 - held)
Status: >= 75% safe, 65–74% warning, below 65% danger

attendance-percentage-calculator.workedExample: Say 40 classes have been held and you attended 28. Percentage = (28 / 40) x 100 = 70.0% — the warning band. To recover to 75%: needed = ceil((0.75 x 40 - 28) / 0.25) = ceil((30 - 28) / 0.25) = ceil(8) = 8 classes in a row. Check: (28 + 8) / (40 + 8) = 36 / 48 = 75.0% exactly. Now flip it: 40 held, 34 attended = 85.0%, safe. Bunkable = floor(34 / 0.75 - 40) = floor(45.33 - 40) = 5 classes. Check: 34 / 45 = 75.6%, still above 75%.
